scenarios.title: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays correctly with all required elements
steps: Load the homepage
Verify hero section is visible within 2 seconds
Check that product name 'MirDB' is displayed in an H1 tag
Verify tagline 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol Support' is visible
Check that animated logo (logo.gif) is displayed with meaningful alt text
Verify 'Get Started' button is present and visible
Verify 'View on GitHub' button is present and visible
scenarios.expectedResult: Hero section loads quickly with all elements properly displayed including logo, title, tagline, and both action buttons

scenarios.title: Get Started Button Navigation
scenarios.description: Verify that the 'Get Started' button scrolls to the Quick Start section
steps: Load the homepage
Click the 'Get Started' button in the hero section
Wait for scroll animation to complete
Verify the viewport has scrolled to the Quick Start section
scenarios.expectedResult: Page smoothly scrolls to the Quick Start section when 'Get Started' button is clicked

scenarios.title: GitHub Button Link
scenarios.description: Verify that the GitHub button links correctly to the repository
steps: Load the homepage
Locate the 'View on GitHub' button
Verify href attribute is 'https://github.com/yetone/mirdb'
Verify target attribute is '_blank' (opens in new tab)
Verify rel attribute contains 'noopener' and 'noreferrer' for security
scenarios.expectedResult: GitHub button has correct URL, opens in new tab, and includes security attributes

scenarios.title: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the features section displays all key features
steps: Load the homepage
Scroll to or locate the features section
Verify H2 heading 'Key Features' is present
Check for Memcached Protocol Compatible feature card
Check for Persistent Storage feature card
Check for Built with Rust feature card
Check for High Performance feature card
scenarios.expectedResult: Features section displays with proper heading and all four feature cards visible

scenarios.title: Demo Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the demo section shows the usage demonstration
steps: Load the homepage
Scroll to or locate the demo section
Verify H2 heading 'Live Demonstration' is present
Check that demo GIF (usage.gif) is displayed
Verify demo image has descriptive alt text
scenarios.expectedResult: Demo section displays with heading and animated GIF demonstration with proper alt text

scenarios.title: Architecture Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the architecture section explains the LSM Tree approach
steps: Load the homepage
Scroll to or locate the architecture section
Verify H2 heading 'Architecture Overview' is present
Check that SVG diagram is displayed with proper accessibility attributes
Verify LSM Tree explanation is present
Check for WAL (Write-Ahead Log) explanation
Check for Memtable explanation
Check for SSTables explanation
scenarios.expectedResult: Architecture section displays with diagram and comprehensive LSM Tree explanation including WAL, Memtable, and SSTables

scenarios.title: Quick Start Installation Instructions
scenarios.description: Verify that installation instructions are provided correctly
steps: Load the homepage
Navigate to the Quick Start section
Locate the Installation subsection
Verify git clone command is present with correct repository URL
Verify cargo build command is present
scenarios.expectedResult: Installation instructions include git clone and cargo build commands

scenarios.title: Quick Start Configuration Example
scenarios.description: Verify that configuration example is provided
steps: Load the homepage
Navigate to the Quick Start section
Locate the Configuration subsection
Verify mirdb.toml configuration example is present
Check for server address configuration
Check for memtable_size configuration
scenarios.expectedResult: Configuration subsection shows mirdb.toml example with server and storage settings

scenarios.title: Quick Start Usage Example
scenarios.description: Verify that basic usage code example is provided
steps: Load the homepage
Navigate to the Quick Start section
Locate the Basic Usage subsection
Verify Python memcache client example is present
Check for client.set() example
Check for client.get() example
scenarios.expectedResult: Basic usage subsection shows Python code example with SET and GET operations

scenarios.title: Supported Operations List
scenarios.description: Verify that supported Memcached operations are listed
steps: Load the homepage
Navigate to the Quick Start section
Locate the Supported Operations subsection
Verify GET operation is listed
Verify SET operation is listed
Verify DELETE operation is listed
Verify ADD operation is listed
Verify REPLACE operation is listed
scenarios.expectedResult: Supported operations list includes GET, SET, DELETE, ADD, REPLACE and other Memcached commands

scenarios.title: Heading Hierarchy Accessibility
scenarios.description: Verify proper heading hierarchy for accessibility
steps: Load the homepage
Count H1 elements (should be exactly 1)
Verify H1 contains 'MirDB'
Check that H2 elements exist for main sections
Verify no heading levels are skipped (H1 -> H2 -> H3)
scenarios.expectedResult: Page has exactly one H1, multiple H2s for sections, and no skipped heading levels

scenarios.title: Image Alt Text Accessibility
scenarios.description: Verify all images have descriptive alt text
steps: Load the homepage
Locate all img elements on the page
Verify each image has a non-empty alt attribute
Verify alt text is descriptive (not just 'image' or 'logo')
Check logo image has meaningful description
Check demo image has meaningful description
scenarios.expectedResult: All images have descriptive alt text that conveys their purpose and content

scenarios.title: Semantic HTML Structure
scenarios.description: Verify semantic HTML elements are used correctly
steps: Load the homepage
Verify presence of header element
Verify presence of main element
Verify presence of footer element
Check for section elements with proper structure
Check for article elements for feature cards
scenarios.expectedResult: Page uses proper semantic HTML with header, main, footer, sections, and articles

scenarios.title: Keyboard Navigation
scenarios.description: Verify all interactive elements are keyboard accessible
steps: Load the homepage
Press Tab key to navigate through interactive elements
Verify all buttons are reachable via keyboard
Verify all links are reachable via keyboard
Check that focus indicators are visible
Verify skip links are present for accessibility
scenarios.expectedResult: All interactive elements can be reached and activated using keyboard only

scenarios.title: Reduced Motion Support
scenarios.description: Verify prefers-reduced-motion media query is supported
steps: Load the homepage
Check CSS for prefers-reduced-motion media query
Verify animations are disabled when reduced motion is preferred
Verify smooth scrolling respects reduced motion preference
scenarios.expectedResult: Page respects user's reduced motion preference and disables animations accordingly

scenarios.title: Footer Display
scenarios.description: Verify footer contains required information
steps: Load the homepage
Scroll to the footer section
Verify GitHub repository link is present
Verify license information (MIT) is displayed
Verify project status is shown
scenarios.expectedResult: Footer displays GitHub link, MIT license, and project status

scenarios.title: SEO Meta Tags
scenarios.description: Verify SEO-related meta tags are present
steps: Load the homepage
Check for title tag with product name
Verify meta description tag is present
Check for Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:type)
Check for Twitter Card tags
Verify canonical URL is set
scenarios.expectedResult: Page includes proper meta tags for SEO and social sharing

scenarios.title: Responsive Design Mobile View
scenarios.description: Verify page displays correctly on mobile devices
steps: Load the homepage on a mobile viewport (320px-480px width)
Verify hero section is readable without horizontal scrolling
Check that buttons are touch-friendly size
Verify feature cards stack vertically
Check that code blocks are scrollable if needed
scenarios.expectedResult: Page is fully functional and readable on mobile devices with proper layout adjustments

scenarios.title: Page Load Performance
scenarios.description: Verify page loads within acceptable time limits
steps: Load the homepage
Measure time to First Contentful Paint
Verify hero section is interactive within 2 seconds
Check that all images load without significant delay
Verify no JavaScript errors in console
scenarios.expectedResult: Page loads quickly with hero section interactive within 2 seconds

scenarios.title: Architecture SVG Accessibility
scenarios.description: Verify the architecture SVG diagram is accessible
steps: Load the homepage
Navigate to the architecture section
Verify SVG has role='img' attribute
Check for title element within SVG
Check for desc element within SVG
Verify aria-labelledby references the title
scenarios.expectedResult: Architecture SVG diagram is accessible with proper ARIA attributes and descriptions

scenarios.title: GitHub Actions Workflow File Exists
scenarios.description: Verify that the GitHub Actions workflow file for GitHub Pages deployment exists and is properly configured
steps: Navigate to the repository root
Check for .github/workflows directory existence
Verify a workflow file exists for GitHub Pages deployment (e.g., deploy.yml, pages.yml, or static.yml)
Open the workflow file and verify it contains GitHub Pages deployment configuration
Check that the workflow triggers on push to main/master branch
scenarios.expectedResult: A GitHub Actions workflow file exists in .github/workflows/ with proper GitHub Pages deployment configuration

scenarios.title: GitHub Pages Workflow Configuration
scenarios.description: Verify the GitHub Actions workflow has correct steps for building and deploying to GitHub Pages
steps: Open the GitHub Pages deployment workflow file
Verify the workflow uses actions/checkout to checkout the repository
Check for build step if the project requires building (e.g., npm build)
Verify the workflow uses actions/configure-pages action
Verify the workflow uses actions/upload-pages-artifact action
Verify the workflow uses actions/deploy-pages action
Check that the workflow has proper permissions (pages: write, id-token: write)
scenarios.expectedResult: Workflow contains all necessary steps and permissions for GitHub Pages deployment

scenarios.title: GitHub Pages Source Configuration
scenarios.description: Verify the correct source directory is configured for GitHub Pages deployment
steps: Open the GitHub Pages deployment workflow file
Identify the upload-pages-artifact step
Verify the 'path' parameter points to the correct build output directory
For static HTML sites, verify path points to root or designated folder
For built projects, verify path points to dist/, build/, or appropriate output directory
scenarios.expectedResult: The workflow correctly specifies the source directory containing the homepage files for deployment

scenarios.title: Deployed Site Accessibility
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage is accessible on the GitHub Pages URL after deployment
steps: Identify the GitHub Pages URL (https://<username>.github.io/<repository>/ or custom domain)
Navigate to the GitHub Pages URL in a browser
Verify the page loads successfully with HTTP 200 status
Check that the hero section is displayed correctly
Verify all images load properly (logo.gif, usage.gif)
Check that CSS styles are applied correctly
Verify navigation and interactive elements work
scenarios.expectedResult: Homepage is fully accessible and functional at the GitHub Pages URL with all assets loading correctly

scenarios.title: Asset Paths Configuration
scenarios.description: Verify that asset paths work correctly when deployed to GitHub Pages subdirectory
steps: Check all image src attributes in HTML files
Verify paths are relative (e.g., './images/logo.gif' or 'images/logo.gif') not absolute
Check all CSS file references use relative paths
Check all JavaScript file references use relative paths
If using a base tag, verify it's set correctly for GitHub Pages repository path
Test that all assets load correctly from the GitHub Pages URL
scenarios.expectedResult: All asset paths are configured to work correctly whether hosted at root or in a subdirectory

scenarios.title: 404 Page Handling
scenarios.description: Verify proper 404 error handling for GitHub Pages
steps: Check if a custom 404.html file exists in the root directory
Navigate to a non-existent URL on the deployed site
Verify that either custom 404 page or GitHub's default 404 page is shown
If custom 404 exists, verify it provides helpful navigation back to homepage
scenarios.expectedResult: Non-existent URLs are handled gracefully with appropriate 404 page

scenarios.title: HTTPS Enforcement
scenarios.description: Verify that GitHub Pages site enforces HTTPS
steps: Navigate to the HTTP version of the GitHub Pages URL
Verify automatic redirect to HTTPS
Check that SSL certificate is valid
Verify no mixed content warnings in browser console
Check all external resources are loaded over HTTPS
scenarios.expectedResult: Site enforces HTTPS with valid certificate and no mixed content issues

scenarios.title: GitHub Pages Deployment Status
scenarios.description: Verify that GitHub Pages deployment completes successfully
steps: Navigate to the repository on GitHub
Go to Settings > Pages section
Verify GitHub Pages is enabled
Check the deployment source is set to GitHub Actions
Go to Actions tab and verify the latest deployment workflow succeeded
Check for any deployment errors or warnings in workflow logs
scenarios.expectedResult: GitHub Pages is enabled and the deployment workflow completes successfully without errors
